choices.why: No sofa in the catalog is dark green velvet, so this is the closest match: a deep teal sofa with a button-tufted back, flared arms and tailored lines, elegant against the pale blue-green walls.
A pair of classic oatmeal wingback chairs with nailhead trim, set facing each other to frame the fireplace and soften the deep sofa.
A large traditional wool rug with a central medallion and fringed ends, big enough to anchor the whole seating group.
A dark walnut coffee table with an X-shaped trestle base and a molded edge, classic and solid, and it echoes the dark mantel.
A large rectangular mirror in champagne gold with classic fretwork, made to sit over a fireplace on the chimney breast.
A floor lamp with a pleated fabric shade and a nickel stem, timeless and elegant beside an armchair.

answer.why: The deep teal sofa, oatmeal wingback chairs, dark wood coffee table and medallion rug make a classic living room centered on the dark fireplace. The gold mirror and the pleated-shade lamp add a quiet, elegant touch that suits the room's moldings and coffered ceiling.
